stepsTitle: The subsidy staircase, step by step
steps[0].note: Set in 2014 and frozen for eight years.
steps[1].note: First of the three instalments of the raise approved in December 2022.
steps[4].note: From 1 February 2025, and in force today.
perks.title: The salary is only the part you see
perks.intro: Comparing the subsidy with the minimum wage understates the bill, because the subsidy is what lands on the payslip — not what the mandate costs. Beside it sit an office allowance, a parliamentary quota and a housing allowance, each with a value set by an act of the Chamber's own Board and published by the Chamber itself.
perks.items[0].label: Salary (subsídio)
perks.items[0].note: The gross monthly pay, identical for a federal deputy and a senator (Constitution, art. 49, VII). Set by Legislative Decree 172/2022.
perks.items[1].label: Housing allowance
perks.items[1].note: Paid to those who do not occupy one of the 432 official flats. It can be taken in cash, with no receipt — in which case 27.5% income tax is withheld. Board Act 3/2015.
perks.items[2].label: Office allowance
perks.items[2].note: Pays up to 25 parliamentary secretaries, "who can be chosen freely (with no need for a public examination)", in the Chamber's own words. Board Act 117/2016.
perks.items[3].label: Parliamentary quota (CEAP)
perks.items[3].note: Varies by state, because it accounts for the airfare from Brasília to the state capital: from R$ 41,612.55 (DF) to R$ 58,474.70 (RR). It covers office rent, flights, meals, fuel and car hire. Board Act 43/2009.
perks.honesty.title: What he earns and what he moves
perks.honesty.text: The salary and the housing allowance land in the member's pocket. The office allowance pays up to 25 people he picks with no public examination, and the quota reimburses the costs of the mandate. Two columns, and both come out of the same tax.
perks.punch: That is 126 minimum wages a month, per member of Congress — and 31 of them land straight in his own pocket.
perks.question: If the salary is R$ 46,000 and the mandate costs more than R$ 200,000 a month, which of the two figures shows up when they debate their own raise?
title: One seat in Congress costs 126 minimum wages a month
intro: A federal deputy's salary is R$ 46,366.19. That is not what the mandate costs. Beside it sit an office allowance, a parliamentary quota and a housing allowance — each with a value set by an act of the Chamber's own Board and published by the Chamber itself. Together they pass two hundred thousand reais a month, per member.
level.mandateLabel: what one mandate costs a month
level.note: There are 594 seats — 513 deputies and 81 senators, on the same salary by the Constitution (art. 49, VII).
rule: Value in force in 2026, on both sides.
